particular.en: There are so many more examples. Chinese immigrants, in particular, transformed the food of Southeast Asia.
particular.zh: 还有更多这样的例子。尤其是中国移民，改变了东南亚的食物。

particular.en: And they could only purchase certain quantities of particular foods.
particular.zh: 而且他们只能购买特定数量的特定食物。

particular.en: So, Neil, I mentioned that my jumper was a bit itchy but sometimes I feel itchy for no particular reason.
particular.zh: So, Neil, I mentioned that my jumper was a bit itchy but sometimes I feel itchy for no particular reason.

particularly.en: Politicians don't tend to be particularly good at admitting they were wrong.
particularly.zh: 政客通常都不怎么擅长承认自己犯了错。

particularly.en: British cuisine is also particularly good at pies and pastries.
particularly.zh: 英国菜在馅饼和糕点方面也特别擅长。

particularly.en: And people’s school food had a particularly poor reputation.
particularly.zh: 人们的学校餐饮有着特别糟糕的名声。

parliament.en: And then, in May 2025, the Belgian parliament did something people weren't expecting.
parliament.zh: 然而，在2025年5月，比利时议会做出了出人意料的举动。

panel.en: Enough wind turbines and solar panels could deliver all the energy a country needed.
panel.zh: 只要有足够的风力发电机和太阳能电池板，就能提供一个国家所需的所有能源。

partial.en: As you may remember, Three Mile Island was the site of a famous partial meltdown back in 1979, but that happened in the other reactor .
partial.zh: 你可能还记得，三哩岛在1979年曾发生过一次著名的部分熔毁事故，但那是发生在另一座反应堆上。

payment.en: Let's say, for the sake of example, a nuclear power plant takes 10 years to build, you will pay €1 billion in interest payments on a €1 billion loan.
payment.zh: 假设建一座核电站需要10年时间，那么在10亿欧元的贷款上，你光是利息就要支付10亿欧元。

payment.en: If banks and investors provide you with €1 billion in financing at a 10% interest rate , let's say, that's €100 million in interest payments every year.
payment.zh: 比方说，如果银行和投资者为你提供10亿欧元的融资，利率为10%，那么每年光是利息支出就有1亿欧元。

pattern.en: Fusion has been "twenty years away" for about seventy years, and 2026 hasn't quite broken that pattern.
pattern.zh: 核聚变处于“距离实现还有二十年”的状态已经大约七十年了，而2026年也并未完全打破这一规律。

partly.en: And this is actually partly where the stereotype of British food becoming bad comes from.
partly.zh: 这也是英国食物变坏的刻板印象部分来源。

partly.en: Meat was cooked until it was extremely well done , partly due to misunderstandings about food safety.
partly.zh: 肉被煮到非常熟的程度，部分原因是由于对食物安全的误解。
